question: How does earth shine from Sivahood onward?
premises: from Sivahood onward light-nature is taken in own self
earth shines with all tattva-chain qualities
inference: Earth shines with all tattva-chain qualities because light-nature is taken from Sivahood onward.
plain_english: Therefore from Sivahood taking light-nature in own self, earth shines with all tattva-chain qualities; pervader-ness is established enough.
